title: Host credit watcher voids a passing gate when Cargo atomically creates a fresh worktree's target directory (transient target<random> sibling)
outcome: A check whose own build creates the worktree's Cargo build directory for the first time keeps its credit. The watcher does not count Cargo's transient atomic-create sibling (a "target" directory name plus random suffix, created with CACHEDIR.TAG and renamed to target) as a source write. Real source changes during a run still void credit. A regression test reproduces the rename pattern.
acceptance: Host credit watcher voids a passing gate when Cargo atomically creates a fresh worktree's target directory (transient target<random> sibling) is done
